replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
Care to explain how you were able to fly without any mods at all just by pressing two keys with a vanilla minecraft? I can ensure that if the game hasn't ended no fly permissions are granted to you, plus if you were able to fly because of a plugin error, you would have also been put into adventure mode where you can't break obsidian or any blocks (except one or two I believe).

Let's put it this way.

It wasn't minecraft, people would have found out, even it being 1.8.8, and not any weird snapshot.
It wasn't avicus' plugins.

It can only be you, or who would it be it otherwise?

replies.author: Mooriie
replies.body: I think ive found the problem, I have had an old client that i didnt delete from my .minecraft It was called More Features, Ive forgotten to delete this folder, and have never checked, This is for single player but it also works for multiplayer and you have to press f9 and lets you fly, obviously i did not know how to turn this feature off and thought it was a glitch with server or minecraft itself, I am sorry for causing such a fuss when it was my own problem.

replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
With that you admit you have hacked, with a mod or whatever you want to call it (also I'd recommend finding another name, I can't find any mod or client called More Features and nor did I with any mod or client that makes you fly with f9). Then again, how come you pressed f9 while "falling"? It's quite far from anything you would want to use while dying. Also you said it was r + spacebar, not f9. 

It's quite obvious that you are lying to us to cover yourself from a blatant flyhacking that ruined the game for many players, including yourself. If you want to take my tip, I would wait a decent amount of time and then come back apologizing for what you did and you may have the chance to get unbanned.

Please refrain from creating more appeals in the near future, and take this time to think about what you did and what you should never do again.

Regards,
Javi.
